claims.text: This repository is a service with 17 routes, consumers, or scheduled jobs.
It contains 30 Java source files totaling 1,899 lines, 12 HTML files, 5 CSS files, and 7 SQL files.
The project supports both Maven and Gradle builds as indicated by the presence of pom.xml and build.gradle.
CI/CD is configured via GitHub Actions workflows for Maven builds, Gradle builds, and cluster deployment, and Docker support includes a Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml.
The application includes dependencies for three databases: H2, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
Docker Compose defines a MySQL service using image mysql:9.7 and a PostgreSQL service using image postgres:18.4.
MySQL connection settings MYSQL_URL, MYSQL_USER, and MYSQL_PASS are read from the environment in src/main/resources/application-mysql.properties.
PostgreSQL connection settings POSTGRES_URL, POSTGRES_USER, and POSTGRES_PASS are read from the environment in src/main/resources/application-postgres.properties.
15 of 17 traced routes reach the database.
POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/edit is handled by PetController.processUpdateForm in src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner/PetController.java.
The framework first runs PetController.populatePetTypes, PetController.findOwner, and PetController.findPet before the handler.
PetController.processUpdateForm calls PetController.updatePetDetails and PetController.isDuplicatePetNameViolation.
PetController.populatePetTypes reaches the database via PetTypeRepository.findPetTypes in PetController.java.
POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets/new is handled by PetController.processCreationForm in PetController.java.
The framework first runs PetController.populatePetTypes, PetController.findOwner, and PetController.findPet before the handler.
PetController.processCreationForm calls Owner.addPet in Owner.java and PetController.isDuplicatePetNameViolation.
PetController.processCreationForm reaches the database via OwnerRepository.saveAndFlush in PetController.java.
GET /vets.html is handled by VetController.showVetList in src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/vet/VetController.java.
VetController.showVetList calls VetController.findPaginated and VetController.addPaginationModel.
VetController.findPaginated reaches the database via VetRepository.findAll in VetController.java.
GET /vets is handled by VetController.showResourcesVetList in VetController.java.
VetController.showResourcesVetList calls Vets.getVetList in Vets.java.
VetController.showResourcesVetList reaches the database via VetRepository.findAll in VetController.java.
The application starts from the PetClinicApplication class in src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/PetClinicApplication.java.
There are 17 HTTP routes defined across six controllers.
OwnerController handles seven routes for owner management including listing, finding, creating, viewing, and editing owners.
PetController provides four routes for creating and editing pets under specific owners.
VisitController exposes two routes for creating visits for specific pets.
VetController serves two routes for viewing veterinarians at /vets and /vets.html.
WelcomeController maps the root path /.
CrashController provides a single route at /oups.
The codebase has 30 Java source files totaling 1,899 lines, 5 CSS files with 9,920 lines, 12 HTML files with 546 lines, and 7 SQL files with 344 lines.
The owner package (src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner) uses the model package with 4 references.

The root petclinic package uses the model package with 2 references.
The root petclinic package uses the vet package with 1 reference.
Test code in the owner test package references the main owner package 25 times.
Test code in the service test package references the main owner package 6 times.
Owner.java is used by 10 other files.
Pet.java is used by 10 other files.
PetType.java is used by 9 other files.
OwnerRepository.java is used by 8 other files.
Vet.java is used by 7 other files.

src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner/OwnerController.java changed in 3 commits by 2 authors during that period.
src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner/OwnerControllerTests.java changed in 3 commits by 3 authors during that period.

CI runs ./mvnw -B verify in the maven-build.yml workflow.
CI deploys to a cluster with kubectl apply -f k8s/ in the deploy-and-test-cluster.yml workflow.
CI waits for demo-db and petclinic pods to become ready with kubectl wait commands.
